data.name: Title
data.value: Claude Code tasks

data.name: Description
data.value: Say « Ask Claude Code to… » and Jarvis starts a Claude Code session on one of your allowed folders. The session reads freely in that folder; every write and every command waits for your answer.

data.name: InstallLabel
data.value: Claude Code on this computer

data.name: InstallHint
data.value: Jarvis looks for the claude program in the PATH.

data.name: Install_Unavailable
data.value: This host cannot start Claude Code.

data.name: Install_Looking
data.value: Looking for Claude Code…

data.name: Install_Missing
data.value: Claude Code was not found. Install it, then open this page again.

data.name: Install_Old
data.value: Claude Code {0} was found. Jarvis was checked with version {1} and later: update Claude Code.

data.name: Install_Unknown
data.value: Claude Code was found, but it did not tell its version. Jarvis was checked with version {0} and later.

data.name: Install_Found
data.value: Claude Code {0} was found.

data.name: Note_ReadOnly
data.value: A session starts read-only: it reads, lists and searches in its folder without asking.

data.name: Note_Approve
data.value: Every write and every command is shown to you, with the exact path or the whole command, and waits for your answer. Nothing outside the folder of the session is ever allowed.

data.name: Note_Watch
data.value: If a write or a command runs without having asked, Jarvis stops the session.

data.name: Note_OwnSettings
data.value: A session started by Jarvis loads neither your own Claude Code settings nor your hooks.

data.name: SessionsLabel
data.value: Sessions started by Jarvis

data.name: SessionsHint
data.value: Stopping a session ends its work at once; its task is marked abandoned.

data.name: NoSession
data.value: No session is running.

data.name: Stop
data.value: Stop

data.name: BudgetLabel
data.value: Cap of a session (US dollars)

data.name: BudgetHint
data.value: Claude Code stops a session that reaches it. From {0} to {1}. When Claude Code counts against the monthly cap, a session never gets more than what is left of it.

data.name: MostLabel
data.value: Sessions at the same time

data.name: MostHint
data.value: From 1 to {0}.

data.name: TrustedLabel
data.value: Trusted folders

data.name: TrustedHint
data.value: Unchecked, a session only reads the CLAUDE.md file at the root of the folder. Checked, it loads the full settings of the project.

data.name: TrustedWarning
data.value: A trusted folder runs the hooks of its repository without asking you. Check only a folder whose content you wrote or read.

data.name: NoFolder
data.value: No folder is allowed yet: add one on the Allowed folders page.

data.name: NotANumber
data.value: This is not a number.

data.name: SaveFailed
